responses.value: Extend the shuttle to the stadium district. A survey says 40% of event visitors would ride it, cutting event-day parking demand by about 1,500 cars across 120 event days a year, and the stadium owner will pay $300,000 of the $800,000 yearly cost. The main risk is that survey intent overstates real ridership. The next step is a one-season pilot on event days that counts riders before committing.
Hold. The stadium still pays $300,000 and 40% of visitors would ride. Extend the shuttle.
